Massage gift certificates from Essence were handed out to trivia question winners and the Platte River Bar and Grill kicked ion gift certificates for bar tabs as well, really rounding out a fun night. The night went smoothly and well, not heavily attended, possibly due to the Broncos game ending right then and everyone being footballed out?
